title: Lat34 Softbrake
description:
Latitude is CRL's premium barn-door-style sliding system for glass and other heavy panels, launched in August 2024. Stopping a heavy glass panel raises safety, noise and wear concerns, so we added soft-close.

We moved to the supplier's second-generation track, which is backward compatible and houses an integrated Soft-Brake. Three Soft-Brake units cover panels from 60 to 300 lb, sit entirely inside the track profile, can be positioned anywhere along it and can be added after installation. Testing meets or exceeds DIN and ANSI standards, including the ADA disengage force. The new track also cost less than the one it replaced, which helped offset the cost of the soft-close.

brief.label: Problem
brief.text: Operating heavy glass panels on the existing sliders raised concerns about safety, noise and component wear.

brief.label: Solution
brief.text: Second-generation tracks that accept a fully integrated, adjustable Soft-Brake, in brushed stainless and black.

brief.label: Customers
brief.text: Architects, temperers and glazing contractors working on luxury offices and residences.

brief.label: Value
brief.text: A more premium, safer user experience, especially for heavy panels, on a system that was already growing quickly.

brief.label: Sourcing
brief.text: Buy: from the system's original supplier, with existing inventory exchanged for the new track.

brief.label: Competition
brief.text: Pemko W100, KN Crowder, Häfele Flatec II.
